papers.title: Learning optimal gaits and styles for terrain-adaptive quadruped locomotion
papers.status: arXiv preprint 2611.25958: first submission2026-11-19; actual local PDF internal stamp2611.25958v2 [cs.RO]21 Nov2026; no acceptance verified
papers.read_scope: Full PDF downloaded from unversioned official URL; first-page internal stamp verifies v2 (21 Nov2026). Methods (rhythm/pattern formation, Stage1/2, onboard heightmap, training, evaluation), relevant limitations and supplemental parameter sections read. This is selected full-text-method reading, not a claim to have read every word/page or verified official code.
papers.key_method: 11 imposed CPG coupling matrices; 11D action height/clearance/xoff/4 amplitudes/4 frequencies at33Hz; Stage1 PPO all-gait/style, Stage2 frozen low-level gait selector;1kHz CPG+IK+PD; onboard depth-to-heightmap CNN/GRU trained by DAgger.
papers.limitations: Terrain mostly geometry, coupling not learned; commanded oscillator phase does not force actual contact; success-conditioned non-success metrics; no deformable-material memory guarantee.

papers.title: LoComposition: Terrain-Adaptive Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion without Gait Priors
papers.read_scope: Official full PDF downloaded; Methods3, controlled ablations/results4, limitations5, hardware/perception scope read.
papers.key_method: Task velocity reward + CaT operational constraints + ramped mechanical absolute-power penalty +13x11 height map; no air-time/contact-count/clearance priors; same PPO/architecture/action for controlled ablations;50Hz joint offsets.
papers.limitations: Policy remains trot at all tested speeds; hardware uses mapping/state-estimation stack, fully onboard state estimation future work; CaT not formal runtime safety; cross-embodiment retrained; no material-history-conditioned orbit theorem.

papers.title: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
papers.status: arXiv 2610.01260v1 preprint; TRO submission is not acceptance
papers.read_scope: Official full PDF downloaded; MethodsIII objective/prior factorization, encoder stop-grad paths, critic/GAE/PPO, diversity and ExperimentalIV comparison/evaluation read; not entire every appendix in this pass.
papers.key_method: 3 semantic critic heads tracking/stability/efficiency; fixed gait prior outside preference vector; history encoder aligned to privileged encoder; actor gradients stop at auxiliary latent/velocity; scalarized GAE and PPO; symmetric KL diversity coefficient1e-5.
papers.limitations: 12 joint positions, flat-terrain4096 Go2 sims; retains contact timing/balance priors; all reported evaluation preferences fixed per rollout; torque-effort proxy is not battery energy; no differentiable dynamics-model gradient.

papers.title: Exciting families of passive gaits in an elastic quadruped via natural motion manifold control
papers.read_scope: Official TU Delft accepted/full PDF downloaded; families3, transverse coordinates/linearization/input/nullspaces/stability/energy regulator4, hardware6 and scope read.
papers.key_method: Poincare-section fixed-point curve parameterized by energy; linearize transverse dynamics; nullspace-separated transverse stabilization and PI energy injection; local Schur condition; passive orbit family instead of single imposed cycle.
papers.limitations: Input full-rank/controllability and conservative-family assumptions; small-loss approximation;3kg BERT SEA sagittal treadmill bounding~0.14/.20m/s; actual dissipative motion near manifold; cannot transfer theorem directly to3D Go2 soft-ground hybrid model.

papers.title: Terramechanics-Aware Adaptive Quadrupedal Locomotion via Foot-Terrain Interaction Model
papers.read_scope: Official IEEE metadata/abstract verified only. Full text and code not obtained; JS wall and no official OA copy found in searches. Do not label deeply read.
